title: Georgia city moves pre-Civil War house for hotel; $500,000 restoration turns it into coffee shop
summary_full: After a careful relocation and restoration, the historic McCray House in Acworth, Georgia, is gearing up to welcome visitors as the new Bizarre Coffee shop. The city has committed nearly half a million dollars to preserve this pre-Civil War building, ensuring it continues to be a vibrant part of the community. As the coffee shop prepares to launch, it promises to inspire fresh memories in the heart of town.
